automation_contract.daily_use_rule: Duplicate a master template before replacing assets. Never write daily content directly into the master templates.
automation_contract.replacement_rule: Replace whole flat PNG/JPG images into the named frames. Do not split uploads into background/person/object layers. Do not use image_to_design, Magic Layers, or old Canva design asset ids unless the asset is verified as a complete flat image.

templates.name: Mira Template Master - A Contact Sheet
templates.use_when: General weekday outfit posts and most daily trend carousels.

templates.name: Mira Template Master - B Symmetric
templates.use_when: Quiet, balanced, formal editorial posts where symmetry and calm presentation matter.

templates.name: Mira Template Master - C Noir Evening
templates.use_when: Night, black, evening, low-light, autumn, winter, or stronger fashion-editorial moods.

templates.name: Mira Template Master - D Full-Bleed
templates.use_when: The photos are strong and the post should maximize visual impact with the highest image weight.

templates.name: Mira Template Master - E Weekend Air
templates.use_when: Weekend, linen, cafe, soft daylight, airy negative space, or quieter daily-life posts.
